title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: Lumsanews reports on Giglietto's research into the consequences of Facebook's algorithmic adjustments during recent election cycles. The piece explains that official political accounts lost up to 73.4% of their reach compared to 2021, and cites Giglietto as an expert source on how platforms manipulate public opinion.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.

title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: A detailed report by the news site Open discussing the findings of Fabio Giglietto's study. The article explains how Meta's algorithms have suppressed official political speech in Italy, resulting in fringe and conspiracy-theory accounts gaining the highest total visibility on the platform, and notes that Italian lawmakers are considering a bipartisan regulatory response.
description: A news report by Open detailing a study led by Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino on how Meta's algorithms suppress official political speech in favor of fringe, anti-European accounts.
